title: Predictive model establishment for forward-head posture disorder in primary-school-aged children based on multiple machine learning algorithms.
summary: Full primary article reports cross-sectional classification of existing forward-head posture in children (514 included, 300 cases), RF AUC .865. It does not predict onset and lacks external validation.
ai_technology: LASSO feature selection and six classifiers model existing posture status.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: 514 children, 300 with posture; random forest AUC .865.
evidence.unknown: Internal split/CV only; cross-sectional status does not establish incidence or prevention.
